importantAssumptions: Main app seed projects include active/current WIP, closeout AR, and 2026 billing/cost-only projects that need review.
Jobs 140-180 are treated as prior/closed unless updated; J158 is kept active.
As of 2026-05-21, 14 projects are in active construction per schedule + PO register: J158, J197, J204-J207, J209-J210, J212, J214-J216, J218.
Contract Amount in the WIP-facing financial table is the 2026 portion, not always full lifetime contract.
Missing cost budgets use an 80% cost / 20% target profit assumption where needed.
Self-performed vs subcontractor split is inferred from project-cost detail accounts; committed subcontract amounts should replace this when available.
